summary: TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. filed an 8-K solely to report a routine monthly sale of unregistered limited partnership units in its continuous private offering, disclosing aggregate consideration of $99.2 million for Class I, S, and F units. The filing also notes that the T-POP Fund Complex issued interests for about $119.1 million. There is no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or special structural feature; it is an ordinary operational disclosure under Items 3.02 and 8.01, lacking any event-driven special situation. No regulatory clock or risk-arb angle applies.
